# Paladin AI

> Paladin AI is an AI-powered infrastructure monitoring and incident response system that watches your systems 24/7 and responds to anomalies in natural language.

## What is Paladin AI?

Paladin AI connects to your existing observability stack — Prometheus, Loki, Grafana, and Alertmanager — and gives you a conversational AI that can query metrics, read logs, interpret alerts, and reason about incidents without requiring you to write PromQL or grep through log lines manually.

It is not a dashboard replacement. It is an always-on AI agent with persistent memory that learns your infrastructure over time and surfaces context when something breaks.

## Core Capabilities

- **Natural language queries**: Ask questions like "why is the API latency high?" and get answers backed by live Prometheus metrics and Loki logs.
- **Alert triage**: When Alertmanager fires, Paladin correlates the alert with recent metric changes and log patterns to give you a root cause hypothesis.
- **Persistent memory**: Paladin remembers past incidents and resolutions. When a pattern recurs, it surfaces what fixed it last time.
- **Multi-source correlation**: Joins signals from Prometheus (metrics), Loki (logs), and Grafana (dashboards) in a single reasoning pass.
- **LangGraph agent architecture**: Built on LangGraph for structured, auditable multi-step reasoning chains.

## Technology Stack

- Agent runtime: LangGraph (Python)
- LLM: Claude (Anthropic)
- Metrics source: Prometheus / Grafana
- Log source: Loki
- Alert source: Alertmanager
- Frontend: Next.js + TailwindCSS
- Deployment: Cloudflare Pages (landing), self-hosted agent

## Who is Paladin AI for?

- Platform engineers and SREs who are on-call and want faster root cause analysis
- DevOps teams running Kubernetes workloads with Prometheus-based monitoring
- Small engineering teams without a dedicated observability specialist
- Any team that already has Grafana/Prometheus but spends too much time correlating signals manually
